testimonials.quote: Before STARSKY, cold-emailing professors rarely got responses. Through STARSKY, I connected directly with a PMRF PhD scholar at IISc Bengaluru and contributed to a NeurIPS workshop submission.
STARSKY helped me find motivated undergraduate interns with the exact PyTorch and linear algebra skills needed for our multimodal interpretability experiments—saving weeks of screening.
Interdisciplinary medical research requires students from both life sciences and computer science. STARSKY's structured domain taxonomy makes cross-disciplinary collaboration effortless.

website_settings.hero_heading: Where Student Ambitions Meet Research Excellence.
website_settings.hero_description: Discover research opportunities, connect with experienced PhD scholars, and turn your academic curiosity into real-world research experience.
website_settings.about_title: Bridging Academic Curiosity and Doctoral Research Mentorship
website_settings.about_content: STARSKY was founded to solve a fundamental disconnect in higher education: thousands of PhD scholars possess deep domain expertise in experimental design, scientific computing, clinical analysis, and academic publishing, while ambitious undergraduate and postgraduate students struggle to find structured research guidance beyond their immediate classrooms. STARSKY creates a verified, transparent bridge where scholars mentor capable student collaborators on real-world research problems.
website_settings.mission_statement: To democratize access to high-impact academic research mentorship by connecting motivated undergraduate and postgraduate students with verified PhD scholars across every discipline.
website_settings.vision_statement: A global academic ecosystem where every curious student can contribute to frontier research and every doctoral scholar can build agile, collaborative research teams.
website_settings.contact_address: STARSKY Academic Innovation Hub, Research Park, Bengaluru 560012, India
website_settings.footer_text: STARSKY is a dedicated academic research collaboration and internship discovery platform connecting verified PhD scholars with undergraduate and postgraduate students.
website_settings.seo_title: STARSKY — Connecting Research Minds. Creating Opportunities.
website_settings.seo_description: Discover research internships and mentorship under verified PhD scholars across Engineering, Medicine, Science, Management, Law, and Humanities.
